product_overview: SindCON is a multi-tenant SaaS platform for condominium management that centralizes finance, communication, security, reservations, and resident self-service. It supports modular enablement per condominium, strict tenant isolation, and integrations with Asaas and Evolution API for payments and messaging.
core_goals: Centralize condominium operations in a single SaaS platform
Provide tenant-isolated workflows for each condominium
Support modular feature toggles per condominium
Enable secure resident, syndic, porter, and admin self-service
Automate financial billing, reporting, and payment reconciliation
Improve communication and emergency response with multi-channel notifications
Support operational modules like reservations, packages, access control, assemblies, pets, rides, and marketplace
Expose public health and webhook endpoints for operational reliability

features.name: Health Check API
features.description: Public endpoint used to verify that the application is running and responding correctly.
user_flows: GET /api/health without authentication -> Receive 200 with application health status -> System reports service availability for monitoring
GET /api/health during an outage -> Receive non-200 or degraded status response -> Monitoring detects service issue

features.name: Authentication API
features.description: Authenticated endpoints for retrieving the current user profile and wallet/credits information.
user_flows: GET /api/user with a valid Sanctum token -> Receive 200 with authenticated user profile -> GET /api/user/credits with the same token -> Receive 200 with user credits details
GET /api/user without a token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> GET /api/user/credits without a token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Charges API
features.description: Manage condominium charges, including listing, creation, bulk creation, charge details, and Asaas payment generation.
user_flows: GET /api/charges with a valid token and condominium context -> Receive 200 with Charge[] -> POST /api/charges with unit_id, amount, and due_date -> Receive 201 with created Charge -> GET /api/charges/{charge} -> Receive 200 with charge details -> POST /api/charges/{charge}/generate-asaas -> Receive 200 with payment generation data
POST /api/charges with missing or invalid unit_id/amount/due_date -> Receive 422 Validation error -> GET /api/charges/{charge} for a missing charge -> Receive 404 Not found
POST /api/charges/bulk-create with authenticated user but invalid condominium/module access -> Receive 403 Forbidden -> Bulk creation is blocked by tenancy or module rules

features.name: Reservations API
features.description: Handle space reservations, availability checks, approvals, rejections, and list views for condominium spaces.
user_flows: GET /api/spaces with a valid token -> Receive 200 with Space[] -> GET /api/reservations/availability/{spaceId} -> Receive 200 with availability information -> POST /api/reservations with reservation data -> Receive 201 with Reservation -> POST /api/reservations/{reservation}/approve -> Receive 200 with approved Reservation

GET /api/reservations without condominium access -> Receive 401 Unauthorized or 403 Forbidden -> POST /api/reservations with conflicting schedule data -> Receive 422 or business-rule error response -> POST /api/reservations/{reservation}/reject -> Receive 200 with rejected Reservation
GET /api/reservations/availability/{spaceId} for a disabled spaces module -> Receive 403 Forbidden -> Reservation actions are blocked by module toggle

features.name: Packages API
features.description: Register packages, preview OCR label extraction, find packages by pickup code, list packages, and mark them collected.
user_flows: POST /api/packages/label/preview with a package label image -> Receive 200 with OCR/matching preview data -> POST /api/packages with package data -> Receive 201 with Package -> POST /api/packages/pickup/find with the pickup code -> Receive 200 with matching Package -> POST /api/packages/{package}/collect -> Receive 200 with collected Package

POST /api/packages/label/preview with unreadable or low-quality image -> Receive 200 with low-confidence or no-match preview -> POST /api/packages/pickup/find with an invalid pickup code -> Receive 404 or not-found response -> POST /api/packages/{package}/collect for an already collected package -> Receive 409 or business-rule error
GET /api/packages without package module access -> Receive 403 Forbidden -> Package operations are blocked for disabled module or defaulter-restricted users

features.name: Marketplace API
features.description: Provide an internal resident marketplace for listing and viewing items.
user_flows: GET /api/marketplace with a valid token -> Receive 200 with MarketplaceItem[] -> POST /api/marketplace with listing data -> Receive 201 with MarketplaceItem -> GET /api/marketplace/{id} -> Receive 200 with marketplace item details
POST /api/marketplace with missing required fields or too many images -> Receive 422 Validation error -> GET /api/marketplace/{id} for a missing item -> Receive 404 Not found
GET /api/marketplace while user is blocked by defaulter restrictions -> Receive 403 Forbidden -> Marketplace access is denied until the user is regularized or granted temporary override

features.name: Access Control API
features.description: Manage visitor authorizations, porteiro dashboard data, and check-in by PIN or QR code.
user_flows: GET /api/access-control/porteiro/panel with a valid porteiro token -> Receive 200 with dashboard object -> GET /api/access-control/authorizations -> Receive 200 with Authorization[] -> POST /api/access-control/authorizations with visitor data and valid_until -> Receive 201 with Authorization -> POST /api/access-control/check-in/qr with QR token -> Receive 200 with check-in result

POST /api/access-control/authorizations without valid_until for preset 'other' -> Receive 422 Validation error -> POST /api/access-control/check-in/pin with invalid or expired PIN -> Receive 401 or 404 error -> GET /api/entries for unauthorized tenant context -> Receive 403 Forbidden
POST /api/access-control/check-in/qr with a token from another condominium -> Receive 403 or not-found response -> Cross-tenant credential use is rejected

features.name: Assemblies API
features.description: Create assemblies, start sessions, and vote on agenda items.
user_flows: GET /api/assemblies with a valid token -> Receive 200 with Assembly[] -> POST /api/assemblies with agenda data -> Receive 201 with Assembly -> POST /api/assemblies/{assembly}/start -> Receive 200 with started Assembly -> POST /api/assemblies/{assembly}/items/{item}/vote -> Receive 200 with vote result
POST /api/assemblies/{assembly}/items/{item}/vote while the assembly is not started -> Receive 409 or business-rule error -> GET /api/assemblies without module access -> Receive 403 Forbidden
POST /api/assemblies/{assembly}/start by a user without permission -> Receive 403 Forbidden -> Assembly lifecycle action is denied

features.name: Communication API
features.description: List messages, conversations, notifications, start direct conversations, and fetch unread notification counts.
user_flows: GET /api/conversations with a valid token -> Receive 200 with Conversation[] -> POST /api/conversations/direct with recipient data -> Receive 201 with Conversation -> GET /api/messages -> Receive 200 with Message[] -> GET /api/notifications/unread-count -> Receive 200 with unread count object
POST /api/conversations/direct with invalid recipient or missing payload -> Receive 422 Validation error -> GET /api/notifications without authentication -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
GET /api/messages while communication module is disabled -> Receive 403 Forbidden -> Messaging access is blocked by module settings or tenant restrictions

features.name: Financial Transactions API
features.description: Expose financial transactions and financial reports for authenticated and authorized users.
user_flows: GET /api/transactions with financial access -> Receive 200 with Transaction[] -> GET /api/reports/financial -> Receive 200 with financial report object -> GET /api/reports/defaulters -> Receive 200 with defaulters report -> GET /api/reports/balance -> Receive 200 with balance report
GET /api/reports/financial without full financial access -> Receive 403 Forbidden -> GET /api/transactions without authentication -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
GET /api/reports/defaulters for a simplified financial mode condominium -> Receive 403 Forbidden -> Advanced financial reports are blocked until full financial mode is enabled

features.name: Pets API
features.description: Register pets and list them for condominium residents with pet module access.
user_flows: GET /api/pets with a valid token -> Receive 200 with Pet[] -> POST /api/pets with pet registration data -> Receive 201 with Pet -> GET /api/pets again -> Receive updated 200 with Pet[]
POST /api/pets with missing required fields -> Receive 422 Validation error -> GET /api/pets without auth -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /api/pets while pets module is disabled -> Receive 403 Forbidden -> Pet registration is blocked by tenant module settings

features.name: Rides API
features.description: Offer ride sharing, list available rides, and book seats within the condominium community.
user_flows: GET /api/rides with a valid token -> Receive 200 with Ride[] -> POST /api/rides with ride offer data -> Receive 201 with Ride -> POST /api/rides/{ride}/bookings -> Receive 201 with RideBooking
POST /api/rides/{ride}/bookings with no available seats -> Receive 409 or business-rule error -> GET /api/rides without module access -> Receive 403 Forbidden
POST /api/rides with a defaulter-restricted user -> Receive 403 Forbidden -> Ride offers cannot be created by blocked residents

features.name: Panic Alert Web
features.description: Allow authenticated users to send and check active emergency panic alerts from the web interface.
user_flows: POST /panic/send with authenticated user and valid panic type -> Receive 200 with alert object -> GET /panic/check -> Receive 200 with active panic alerts object
POST /panic/send with missing or invalid panic type -> Receive 422 Validation error -> GET /panic/check without authentication -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /panic/send with user lacking access or disabled session -> Receive 403 Forbidden -> Panic alert submission is rejected

features.name: Webhooks
features.description: Receive external payment webhooks from Asaas for payment status synchronization.
user_flows: POST /webhooks/asaas with a valid Asaas webhook payload -> Receive 200 with processing confirmation object -> System updates payment status asynchronously
POST /webhooks/asaas with malformed payload -> Receive 400 or validation error response -> Webhook event is ignored or logged for review

known_limitations.issue: Most API routes require condominium context and active SaaS subscription
known_limitations.impact: Tests need authenticated user with valid condominium and subscription

known_limitations.issue: Module-gated routes depend on condominium module toggles
known_limitations.impact: Some endpoints return 403 if module not enabled for condominium

known_limitations.issue: Defaulter restrictions block certain actions for overdue residents
known_limitations.impact: Marketplace, reservations, rides may be blocked for defaulters
